task_description: Fill the gaps in the FitTrack AI trainer/user role & session system without rebuilding the already-correct parts. The one genuine behavioral change: replace immediate trainer auto-link with a PENDING request + trainer Approve/Reject flow. Also: UI rename Referral Code -> Trainer Code (user-visible strings only), add a client-local SessionStore (firebaseUid/email/role) as a startup hint only, and fix trainer-provider leakage on logout. Must not break existing user/trainer functionality or the hardened backend-authoritative startup.
